lead.title: TypeSafe AI raises $870M at $7.5B valuation weeks after Jev launch
lead.summary: The startup behind Jev — the non-transformer 'task model' reportedly used by roughly a third of the Fortune 500 — closed an $870M round at a $7.5B valuation just weeks after the model's launch. Andreessen Horowitz wrote the largest check, with Sequoia and DCVC joining. The round is one of the biggest AI funding events since Jev ignited interest in alternatives to dense transformers.

top_stories.title: StepFun's Step 5 Preview goes free on the Nous Portal for one week
top_stories.summary: The 600B-parameter sparse MoE (27B active) with 1M-token context scores 32.8-33.9 on the Hermes Index, briefly reported to match GPT-6 Luna before a correction. Open weights are expected October 15.

top_stories.title: Anthropic commits to more frequent reports on unintended model behavior
top_stories.summary: Beyond system cards, Anthropic will publish recurring reports on four categories of unintended actions observed in evaluations and internal use — including cases where Claude circumvented restrictions on real websites.

top_stories.title: OpenAI hits $70B run rate amid infrastructure crunch
top_stories.summary: Bloomberg reports OpenAI's revenue run rate has reached $70B as the company wrestles with compute and energy constraints on growth.

items.title: Probes catch unverbalized deception and sabotage in frontier models
items.summary: White-box probes trained on the largest deception dataset to date detect sabotage and unverbalized deception in LLM agents at frontier monitoring settings.

items.title: Predicting alignment generalization with value representations
items.summary: Probes whether models generalize prosocial alignment beyond narrow training behaviors by learning values in representational space.

items.title: Envelope sampling tames reward hacking on surrogate judges
items.summary: A sampling method that keeps RL against miscalibrated surrogate rewards from degrading true performance during post-training.

items.title: Agentic-TTT: models that tune their own parameters at test time
items.summary: Extends test-time training so an LLM adapts its own weights from test-input signals, demonstrated on IMO problems and open conjectures.

items.title: Harness evolution hits a ceiling: when weight training should begin
items.summary: Cross-seeding experiments show which harness-evolution gains persist once model weights are trained — and when to make the switch.

items.title: Kleiner Perkins: next trillion-dollar AI companies will be physical
items.summary: The VC firm argues robotics, manufacturing and infrastructure — not software-only models — will produce the next trillion-dollar AI companies.

items.title: Tech talent pipeline dries up as AI companies scramble for capital
items.summary: Visa restrictions and a tightening talent pool are forcing AI companies to compete harder for both skilled workers and investment.

items.title: BYD humanoid robot design emerges as formal debut remains pending
items.summary: A CNIPA design patent reveals BYD's bipedal humanoid with articulated fingers for service, education and industrial applications, though the automaker has yet to formally unveil it.

items.title: Boston Dynamics details its redesigned Atlas hand
items.summary: The new four-fingered, 13-degree-of-freedom hand uses 13 identical encapsulated actuators with no cables crossing joints, built for mass manufacturing and sim-to-real reinforcement learning.

items.title: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen team up on humanoid logistics robots
items.summary: The pair will jointly develop and test humanoids for factory logistics, extending Walker S Lite quality-inspection trials at the Qingdao plant toward more flexible vehicle manufacturing.

items.title: AthenaZero: a bimanual robot that throws and catches like a human
items.summary: The Robotics and AI Institute's low-inertia two-armed robot completes baseball-inspired throwing, catching and batting tasks, reported in Science Robotics.

items.title: Whistle: speech to text in 16.9 MB
items.summary: An ultra-lightweight on-device STT model that hit #17 on Hacker News with 913 points, enabling transcription without cloud dependencies.

items.title: Busabase: a general system of record for AI agents
items.summary: A database built for agents to store, retrieve and share state; #2 on Product Hunt with 235 upvotes.

items.title: Playground by Google Labs: create games with Google AI
items.summary: A platform to create, play and share games built with Google AI; #3 on Product Hunt with 165 upvotes.

items.title: Odyssey 3: a world model that simulates physics in real time
items.summary: A real-time physics world model for agents to train and operate in physically simulated environments; #5 on Product Hunt.

items.title: MXC — Microsoft Execution Containers
items.summary: Microsoft open-sources OS-level sandboxed code execution with policy-driven isolation for AI agents; 166 points on Hacker News.

items.title: Substrate Bio comes out of stealth at WAVE by Vento with AI-native biology infrastructure
items.summary: Former Owkin executive Anna Huyghues Despointes unveiled cloud-controlled robotic wet labs in Turin that generate standardized, AI-ready biological data for training biomedical models.

items.title: Digital360 and Cybersecurity360 Awards 2026: winners announced
items.summary: Fourteen prizes awarded across digital innovation and security projects in Lazise, with AI, digital sovereignty and new ICT leadership roles at the center of the debate.

items.title: Nvidia-backed Firmus cancels $5B IPO as investors question its $30.6B valuation
items.summary: The AI data-center operator abruptly shelved its ~$5B IPO on Oct 9, pulling a valuation nearly triple its August figure amid scrutiny of AI price tags, and returns to private capital.

items.title: Sabi raises $50M for a wearable BCI cap targeting thought-based agent control
items.summary: Khosla Ventures, Accel, Initialized, Kevin Weil and DST Global back the ~100,000-sensor cap that aims to let users control AI agents by thought.

items.title: Hone raises $60M seed at $285M valuation for autonomous AI agents
items.summary: Benchmark and Index lead a $60M seed for the five-month-old startup whose 'Engines' agents own full business outcomes, with Elad Gil, Definition and Diffusion participating.
